rationale: The original long thesis has failed as price broke cleanly back below both the 5-minute 9-EMA ($170.24) and session VWAP ($169.82), printing a sequence of lower highs and lower lows down to $169.02. With heavy relative volume (5.08x) on a -5.7% gap down day, the failed VWAP reclaim signals strong overhead supply and renewed downside momentum toward the session low ($165.25). Flipping to short captures this momentum shift with invalidation placed above VWAP and the 5-minute 9-EMA at $170.50, targeting $165.50 for more than a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio.
